(405)༄/ /jo bo mnyam med gser gling pa dang mjal ba'i rnam thar bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (405)༄// jo bo mnyam med gser gling pa dang mjal ba'i rnam thar bzhugs so//

(406)༄༅// rje btsun byams pa dang spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ dge slong dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na bdag gis zla ba bcu gsum gyi bar du gzings kyi nang du zhugs nas/ bla ma gser gling pa'i drung du phyin pa na// zla ba lnga tsam 'das pa'i dus su lha'i bu dbang phyug chen pos kho bo'i byang chub kyi sems kyi bar du gcod pa'i phyir mi mthun pa'i rlung dmar chen po g.yos/ chu srin nya mid chen por byas te mdun bkag /nam mkha' nas kho bo'i steng du thog phab ste/ de'i dus su kho bos byams pa dang snying rje khyad par can gcig bsgoms pa la brten nas/ rlung dmar chen po zhi nas thog chen po drug nam mkha' la chags 'dug pa mthong*/ 'on kyang chu srin des mdun bkag pa dang*/ rlung chen po des rgya mtsho'i kha 'khyams pa'i stobs kyis// gzings de yang dar po che rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin du 'dar ba dang*/ 'phyar ba dang*/ res 'ga' nam mkha' la khyer ba dang*/ res 'ga' rgya mtsho'i gting du rdebs pa dang*/ phyogs kyi ba dan chen po bzhi bsnyal/ khro chu'i pha bong bzhi rgya mtsho'i gting du bskyur kyang*/ phyogs bzhi nas rnga chen po bzhi brdungs pa ltar 'ur sgra dang*/ chom sgra dang*/ 'od dang*/ skam glog chen po byung ba la brten te/ 'khor thams cad kyang shin tu skrag ste/ rab tu 'dar zhing yod pa la/ yang (407)byams pa dang snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa'i snying pos bla ma la gsol ba 'di btab bo// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bla ma thugs rje can// khyed la sa steng 'di na 'gran zla ma mchis na// ding sang nag po'i phyogs kyis 'jigs shing gtse ba 'di// khyed kyi thugs rje chen pos zhi bar mdzad du gsol// 'gro ba thams cad srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol byed na// ding sang nag po'i phyogs kyis 'dir ni mtho mtshams so// e ma rlung dmar g.yos shing gnam lcags rab tu phab// nya mid chen pos mdun du 'jigs pa byas// rje btsun 'jigs pa 'di las bskyab tu gsol// rgya mtsho rlung gis bskyod cing rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo// mi snyan shugs sgra 'don cing glog dmar 'od du g.yos// gzings kyang 'dar 'dar shig shig rab tu g.yos// mkha' la ling ling 'phyar zhing gting du rdeb// rje btsun da ni 'jigs pa 'di las bskyab tu gsol// khyod kyi yon tan nam mkha' lta bu la// bka' sdod chos srung tshogs rnams mkha' lding ltar// ling ling bskor zhing bar chad sel byed na// deng sang 'di ltar bar chad lhags kyang mi skyob par// dben pa'i dbyings na bzhugs pa thugs rje ci ltar chung*// de ni gsang sngags phyi nang mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*// dgra (408)bcom dpa' bo dpa' mo ye shes lha tshogs rnams// dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis// kun nas bskor zhing deng sang rgya mtsho chen po 'dir// bla ma khyed kyis thugs rje'i dpung gis bzlog tu gsol// gzhan gyis mi thub bcom ldan gshin rje gshed dmar la// gshin rje 'jigs par byed pa'i 'khor gyis yongs su bskor// mi g.yo mgon po khro bo bcu yi tshogs dang bcas// 'jigs pa brgyad skyob lha mo bkra shis dpal 'bar ma// chos rgyal bla ma khyed kyis dpung gis bzlog tu gsol// bstan pa'i bdag po rje btsun sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang dri med dkyil 'khor can// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i chos rgyal yab sras gnyis// dus la babs so thugs rje'i pha tshan dpung du skyed// zag med byin rlabs chu rgyun yun du bsring du gsol// zhes gsol ba khyad par can lhang lhang 'debs pa kho bos legs par thos pa dang*/

kho bo yang bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar nag gsus khyim che ba// ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzes pa mig dmar la sdang mig phyogs bcur bsgrad pa/ de mthong tsa na khro bo gzhan gyi lag cha brul ba gcig tu mdzad de/ rdo rje be con nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa klad la bskor nas rdo rje be con gyis brgyab pas/ ri rab la phog nas ri rab tshal par gshag nas ri rab kyi 'og gser gyi sa gzhi'i gting la thug par mtshams phye ste// yar log rgya mtsho chen po dkrugs pas khrag tu khol nas chu srin nya mid de rus pa dkar sangs kyis song ba'i mod las/ byis pa gzhon nu sha med pa gcig tu byas te gzings kyi nang du byung phyag 'tshal zhing thal mo sbyar te// khro bo'i rgyal po shin tu mthu stobs can// thugs rje chen po 'gro ba'i skyabs (409)gcig po// bdag ni 'jigs pas shin tu nongs mod kyi// da ni khyed kyi thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol// zhes zer ba dang*/ bdag gis kyang be con lag tu blangs nas/ hūm̐// nga ni skye 'gro'i srog bdag chen po yin// thugs rje chen po'i dbang gis ni// snying rjes khyod ni ma bsgral lo// da ni bdag gis gdul bya la// mu stegs chos log ma bstan cig /mo bon rdzun chos ma bshad cig /khyod kyi tshe srog nga dbang ngo*// zhes smras pa dang*// khos snyan pa'i tshig phul ba// thugs rje chen po dgongs su gsol// khyod kyi gdul bya rjes 'brang la// log chos gang yang mi bstan gyi// khyod kyis bdag la brtse bar dgongs// khyed ni bdag gi srog bdag lags// zhes skad do// de nas me thab kyi rtsa nas mi dkar po gcig langs byung nas// kha ba can du khyod ma 'grem// bal po'i gzings la sa bcad gyis// zangs gling la sogs gling phran du// ma 'grim chu yis bar mtshams phye/ bhūṃ hrīḥrak+sha zhes pa thos/

de nas rlung dmar thams cad zhi/ mtsho rlabs dang sgra 'od rnams zhi/ gzings chen po yang rnal du phebs nas/ de nas thams cad dbugs rang sar phyin nas/ phan tshun dga' ba'i gleng slong khrol le byung ba dang*/ yang khro bo gshin rje'i gshed kyi bskyed rim ma bshig par/ gzings kyi kha khyer la sa 'ja' yi bzhag nas// rdo rje be con mkhar bar btsug na 'dug pa la/ de nas gzings chen po phrag khrig tsam yang med par gnas gzhi chen po bzhin du 'dug pa la ci yin snyam nas bltas pa dang*/ bu mo gzhon nu ma kha cig bzhad gang zer ba thos nas/ de ltar bltas tsa na khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba 'di pus mo man chad rgya mtsho'i gting bzlas par byas te/ skyes pa dar mas gzhong bzung ba (410)bzhin du gzings kyi shar nub gnyis nas bcus te/ dbu ma'i cod pan sprin gyi gseb nas lhag ge 'dug /gzings kyi kha khyer nas phar la bu mo nyi shu rtsa gcig kha phyir bstan nas/ 'o skol ming srid rnams min na de ring kha rje che ang gsung gin 'dug /de nas kho bos/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ngan song sgo 'gegs ma la phyag 'tshal lo// mtho ris lam 'dren ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rtag tu khyed kyis stong grogs byas// da dung thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa dang*// bud med kun na re// bu sa yi snying po 'di min na/ mu stegs kyi grong khyer swo ba na tha 'di thal bar rlog cig snyam na gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgra de thos pa dang*/ a pa sems can kun gyi mchog kyang sems dpa' chen po 'di yin/ nged rnams kyis kyang 'di drang ba'i phyir 'dir 'ong*// lar byis pa kha sngon po 'di brag na gzhu 'tshag zer zhing byis pa kho de nyi ma de ring phan chad nas bal po'i gzings phar bsgrol cig /sa yi snying po la bos nas tshe dang ldan pa khyod rang nam mkha'i me tog 'di swo ba na thar rgyob la thong skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khab kho bo cag rnams kyis len gsungs pa/

paṇ+ḍi ta sa'i snying pos kyang*/ thog gcig sdigs mdzub la blangs te bskor nas mu stegs kyi grong khyer swo ba na tha'i byang phyogs na lha mo tsa rtsi ka yod pa'i steng du rgyab pas/ mu stegs kyi lha khang lha mo dang bcas pa brlag par byed// yang gcig 'phangs pas dbang phyug chen po nyid kyi rten la rgyab ste tshal par gas nas/ de'i zer gcig mu stegs kyi rgyal po la phog ste gzhog g.yas pa chag zer/ gcig mtha' du ru ka'i pho brang la brgyab pas lo bcu gsum du sog po'i (411)'grim 'grul chad zer// gcig zhang zhung rgyal po gur nag gi pho brang la rgyab nas/ bon gyi bstan pa bsnubs/ re re gnyis gnyis yod pa bred nas ri bo gangs can gyi rgyud du bros zer// gcig lho phyogs kyi dug mtsho nag po la brgyab pas// klu bdud nag po'i pho brang bshig /mdze la sogs pa'i nad rgyun chad zer// gcig yul laṅkar brgyab pas sin po'i rgyal po laṅka pu ri'i pho brang thal bar brlag ste/ srin po mi zan gyi rabs chad/ de nas nga rgyal gyi tshig smras pa/ sa yi dkyil 'khor 'di yi bdag po nga yin gyis// nag po'i phyogs rnams byer cig byer cig thal bar rlog /dpa' bo chen po nga ni sa yi snying po yin// u rgyan yul na rta mgrin rgyal po rta skad 'tsher// rlog cig rlog cig dbang phyug chen po rdul du rlog /bon po'i lha rnams ngo bo'i nus pa brlag par gyis/ oṃ pad+man+ta kṛ ta shwa ta ha ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa ces zer ba thos so// de nas khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyang yud tsam las mi snang ngo*// kho bo yang rang nyid dge slong gi rnam par stan la 'dug ste gda' 'o// rang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i 'khor thams cad kyang yi rangs te/ lhun gyis grub cing ma bcos pa'i// chos rgyal rin chen lhun po 'dra// mtshan rab ye shes mnga' ba des// bdag cag thams cad tshim par byas// e ma ho mgon po mthu dpal can// de bzhin srid pa'i rgya mtsho las// bdag cag 'jigs pas nyen pa na// khyod kyi thugs rje'i skyabs 'og nas// 'chugs pa med par bskyab tu gsol// zhes zer te/

zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bar du gar yang phyin par ma nus nas 'jigs pa las sgrol ma thag tu phyogs bzhir rlung gi ba dan bzhi phyar khro chu'i pha bong bzhi steng du drangs/ mthun pa'i rlung dang sbyar te zla ba phyed dang (412)gnyis kyi bar du nyin mtshan med par rgya mtsho chen po la zhugs te phyin pas zla ba bdun lhag tsam na yang mdun du rlung dmar langs te sngar btang ba'i nyin lam tsam rlung gis khyer yang*// bla ma dkon mchog dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gsol ba btab pas rlung dmar rang zhi yang*/ mthun pa'i rlung chen po tsam yang ma byung pas sems can gyi bsod nams la brten nas zla ba phyed kyi bar lus// de bzhin du byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom zhing mthun pa'i rlung dang sbyar nas phyin pas zla ba gnyis dang zhag nyi shu rtsa drug nas rgya mtsho'i pha rol du phyin par gyur te/ bla ma btsal ba'i phyir dka' ba ji ltar spyad pa'i rnam par bzhag pa las rgya mtshor lha dbang phyug chen po pham par byas pa'i lo rgyus kyi rnam par bzhag pa rdzogs so// ngo mtshar ba lags so/ ༈ /rje btsun byams pa dang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas rgya mtsho chen po bsgral ma thag tu// gser gling gi ljon shing gi nub phyogs/ bde ldan pad+ma'i lho phyogs dam shing 'dam bu'i tshal gyi byang phyogs/ chu srin ke ke ru'i shar phyogs/ bod kyi rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i bde gshegs gser gyi mchod rten gyi drung du/ bla ma gser gling pa'i slob ma dge bshes bsam gtan pa drug yod pa'i sar/ bla ma gser gling pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams rtsad gcod pa la zhag bcu bzhi'i bar bsdad pas// de la bla ma'i thugs dam gyi rim pa gang la mdzad pa dang*/ brgyud pa khung btsun pa gang nas 'ded pa dang*/ gzhung lugs ji tsam gcig thugs la mnga' ba/ lung dang rig pa man ngag du tsam gyi bdag po yin pa/ thugs rgyud 'byongs pa/

rtogs pa'i tshad dang yon tan ci tsam mnga' ba thams cad bsam gtan pa kun la zhus shing bsam gtan pa kun gyis kyang bla ma'i rnam par thar pa bsnon 'phri med par (413)bshad pa la brten nas sa thob pa tsam gyi dga' ba skyes/ bsam gtan pa dag gis kyang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa yi snying po la sogs pa rnams la rnam par thar pa dris pas de rnams kyis kyang rgyal srid spangs nas thar pa sgrub lugs/ bla ma dpag tu med pa brten lugs/ gtsug lag khang dpag tu med pa'i bdag po byas lugs/ yon tan rgya chen po mnga' lugs bshad pa la bsten nas bsam gtan pa kun na re/ 'o na paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'di rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na bya ba yod zer ba de cang min nam zer/ sa'i snying pos smras pa// rgyal ba gnyis par 'jig rten yongs na grags// lnga bcu rtsa gnyis paṇa chen yongs kyis bskor// theg pa che chung yongs kyis bsngags pa de// rgya gar mkhas pa chen por yongs su grags// bsam gtan pa kun gyis smras pa/ sa yi bdag po gnas 'dir lhags pa legs// thos pas snyan pa rgyang nas skye na yang*// de ring bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// mkhas pa chen po gzings la byon pa legs// bar du bdud kyis bgag par ma gyur tam// nya mid rlung gi bar chad ma mchis sam// yun ring 'tshe bas nyen par ma gyur tam// sa yi snying pos lan smras pa// zla ba bcu gnyis gzings su zhugs nas 'ong*// dbang phyug chen pos nya mid rlung dmar g.yos// de nas gzings la slar yang 'ong pa na// rje btsun nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas// brgya dang nyer lnga 'phongs shing dub par gyur// mi mthun phyogs rnams bden pa'i tshig gis zhi// sa yi snying pos tshig de smras pa dang*// bsam gtan pa rnams dga' zhing rab tu dgyes te kho bos phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa'i drung du 'ong ste gus pas 'di skad do// khyod kyi snyan pa rgyang nas thos pa na// dga' ba'i sems kyis (414)mthong na yid smon shor// da 'dir mkhas pa chen po lhag pa na// mi shes mun pa'i sgrib pas non par gyur// da ni lus dang ngag dang yid dag gis// rab tu gus pas khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// kho bo'i drung du phyag 'tshal ba dang*// kho bo slar khengs pa spangs te gus pas phyag bgyis so// yid bsam gtan pa kun gyis smras pa/

skyes bu dam pa gling 'dir lhag pa yi// ched du bya ba gang lags bshad du gsol// gus par khyed kyi bya ba bdag gis bya// ci 'tshal bdag la legs par bka' stsol zhig /kho bos lan smras pa// bdag ni gser gling bla ma'i drung du 'ong*// dal 'byor lus la snying po len du 'ong*// khyed cag myur du bla ma'i drung du song*// zhus la bdag gi 'dod pa'i skabs dbye zhig /de nas bsam gtan pa dag gis bla ma gser gling pa'i drung du phyin nas// kye ma dam pa gsan du gsol/ deng sang gling 'dir rgya gar gyi mkhan pa dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na bya ba de slob ma brgya dang nyer lnga'i tshogs dang bcas te lhan cig tu rgya mtsho chen po la zla ba bcu gnyis kyi bar du bdud dang mu stegs kyi lha dbang phyug chen po byams pa dang snying rjes bcings shing sku gsung thugs mdangs ma shor bar bdag phyogs gang na bder lhags so// de la zhag bcu bzhi'i bar du chos kyi gtam sbrel por mdzad pas bdag cag sems rangs shing tshims par gyur to// da ni skabs kyi don la mkhas pa chen po de khyed kyi drung du 'ong ste/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad skyed par byed pa'i yum gtso bor nyan pa dang*/ smon 'jug byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed de/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyongs bar bgyi/ gzhan yang bla ma'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu nyin mtshan du spyod par 'dod pa gda' bas thugs rje chen pos skabs dbye zhig ces zhus pa dang*// tshig de gsan ma thag (415)tu bla ma'i zhal nas// sa yi bdag po byon pa legs// dpa' bo chen po byon pa legs// 'khor dang bcas te byon pa legs// dga' ba chen po spyad pa legs// dbang phyug nag po btul ba legs// mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba legs// snyan pa'i ba dan sgrogs pa legs// nyes skyon med par slebs pa legs// dge slong thams cad chos gos gsol// dam pa de la bsu ba gyis// dge slong chos gos gsum kha dog mthun par gsol ba/

thams cad mthun par ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang 'khar bsil mdzes par bsnams pa/ shin tu dang ba 'dren pa'i dgra bcom pa lta bu lnga brgya dang sum cu rtsa lnga'i sna bla ma gser gling pas drangs nas// dge tshul drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis brten te/ mdor na rab tu byung ba lnga brgya dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis rgyang ring po nas bsu ba'i phyir nar gyis byung ba mthong ngo*// de ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs pa'i dus na dgra bcom pa rnams kyis bskor ba ltar shin tu dang ba 'dren cing shes pa nyams dga' ba'i mthar thug par gyur te/ de'i tshe kho bos kyang glang po che gnyis la mthun pa'i rkyen rnam la bkal te dge bsnyen bzhis yo byad mgo 'don du bcug go /bla ma la ngoms par bya ba'i phyir rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ sde snod gsum la mkhas pa'i dge slong gcig yan chad chag l+h+wam 'breng mig ma gsol ba/ kha che gur gum gyis legs par kha bsgyur ba'i gos rnam gsum thog ma babs pa phal chen sde pas legs par bsngags pa mdzes par gsol ba/ de thams cad rten 'brel gyi che bas lcags kyi lhung bzed rab tshad rdol bug med pa bsnams pa/ zangs kyi ril ba spyi blugs ma ga dha'i bre gang shong ba/ bstan pa'i bdag pos (416)rab tu bsngags pa 'khar gsil la sogs pa sde tshan thams cad legs par tshang bar yod pa/ thams cad kyang paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhwa nga rgyal med par gsol ba/ rnga yab dkar po re phyag na bsnams pa/ de yang paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'gro ba bzang po// chos kyi bshes gnyen/ dge ba'i 'byung gnas/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ lha yi blo gros/ nyi ma sbas pa/ sa yi snying po/ ye shes snying po/ ngag gi dbang phyug /dha na shrī mi tra/ shes rab bzang po/ zla ba bzang po/ kun tu bzang po/ gsang ba'i snying po/ blo gros mtha' yas/ rgya mtsho rba rlabs/ ri rab rgyal po/ dpa' bo rol pa la sogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rnams dang*/

sde snod gsum la mkhas pa'i dge slong brgya dang brgyad/ dge tshul bcu gsum/ dge slong chen po bzhi ste brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lngas khro bo'i rjes su lam bar du mi re shong ba tsam du ma 'byor bar rgyang ches ma drag pa/ bar ma chad pa 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur bzhin du mgon po gser gling pa ga la der bzhugs pa der phyin pa dang*/ thams cad phun sum tshogs pa sha stag tu gyur pa dang*/ lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phabs so// sngar 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bla ma dang nye bar 'brel yang*/ 'dir sngar gdams pa ma thob pa dang*/ kho bo'i rjes su paṇ+ḍi ta che la mang ba dang*/ bdag cag gis phyag gi mchod pa'i rjes su bla ma'i sku 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis kyang kho bo dang kho bo'i slob ma chen po rnams kyi gzi brjid ma thub par/ thams cad kyang so thar sdom pa nas yon tan thams cad kho bos tshang bar byas pas snying gcig tu yod pa dang*/ thams cad kyang lta spyod mthun pa dang*/ thams cad kyang kho bo'i rjes su slob pa sha stag yod pas lan du phyag lan gyang 'gyel ba bzhin du mdzad do// des rab tu gnas pa mdzad nas phyis kyang kho bo rgya bod thams cad kyis bskur bar (417)gyur to// de'i tshe bdag gis rin po che'i bum pa lto ba che la lhun gyis grub pa/ rtsa ba brtan la mgrin pa ring ba/ kha g.yel ba mchu drang ba nang na dngos po ci yod phyi na gsal ba gcig rin po che dang*/ gser dang*// dngul dang*/ mu tig dang*/ byi ru dang*/ baiḍūr+yas bkang ste bla ma'i phyag tu phul lo// gzhan thams cad kyis kyang gser gyi sbram bu zho re yod pa re phul lo// bla ma dam pa gser gling pas tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas lam gyi bar chad dris pa 'di ltar te// 'dul ba 'dzin pa byon pa legs// tshul khrims gos can byon lags sam// snying rje chen po byon lags sam// chos kyi rgyal po 'dir lhags sam// khyod kyi snyan pa rgyab na che// mthong bas dga' khyod byon lags sam// rgya gar chos kyi pho brang du// rgya chen spyod pas 'gro ba la// phyogs ris med pa'i snying rje yis// mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad lags sam// mkhas pa khungs nas btsun lags sam// bla ma mang pos bskyangs lags sam// mkhas pa mang pos khur lags sam// deng song gnas 'dir byon pa legs// skye rgu'i bdag po rgya mtsho las// zla ba bcu gsum byon zhes thos// dka' ba spyad pa ngo mtshar che// dbang phyug nag po btul zhes thos// snyan pa'i grags pa ngo mtshar che// mkhas pa shul thag ring po la// lus sems dub par ma gyur tam// nag po'i phyogs kyi phrag dog la// snying rjes skyo bar ma gyur tam// skyes bu chen po byon pa legs// gnas na kha 'thor tsam gcig mchis// de dag thos bsam las la zhugs// gzhan rnams khyed kyi mdun du 'ong*// da 'dir mjal ba skal pa zang*// da ni gtsug lag khang du gshegs// 'dus pa'i kun dga' ra bar gshegs// phebs pa'i gsung gleng rim gyis bsnyad// chos dang (418)mthun par 'gro bar bya// zhes pa dang*/
